 APARNA NARAYANAN 
 Updated 04:50 PM ET 11/18/2026
 Gold and silver stocks sank on Wednesday along with precious metals prices after hawkish Federal Reserve comments boosted the U.S. dollar. Shares of Newmont (NEM), Agnico Eagle Mines (AEM), Barrick Mining (B), Wheaton Precious Metals (WPM) and Franco-Nevada (FNV) sustained losses in the 4% to 7% range.
